newsitem.title: USA: Star to restart Louisiana H-oil unit Friday.
newsitem.headline: Star to restart Louisiana H-oil unit Friday.

text.p: Star Enterprises said Thursday it would restart Friday a 35,000-barrel-per-day heavy oil unit at its refinery in Convent, Louisiana, with repairs to the unit completed following a two-month outage.
"We anticipate the unit will be up and running tomorrow," a company spokesman said, noting the unit is used to upgrade residual fuel and other heavy feedstocks into lighter distillates and gasoline.

The unit was shut down Dec 4 after a fire, helping support distillate prices in recent weeks -- particularly low sulfur diesel -- as Star and other refiners bid for scarce barrels in the Gulf Coast, traders said.
Traders said Star was not seen buying Thursday, however.
No other units were damaged in the December fire, the company said, adding the refinery's normal daily crude throughput is 225,000 bpd.
Star is a joint venture of Texaco Inc and Saudi Refinery Inc.
((- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632))
